nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ assign to each unordered pair $\{x, y\}$ of elements of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$ (possibly with $x = y$) an element of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$. A finite set $X \subseteq \{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is independent for $f$ if $f(\{x, y\}) \notin X$ for all distinct $x, y \in X$.
